narration.full_text: In this section, we will explore the fascinating world of Control and Coordination. You will learn about the intricate mechanisms of the nervous system, including how nerve impulses are generated and how reflex actions protect our bodies. We'll delve into the complex structure and vital functions of the human brain. Additionally, we will discover how plants coordinate their movements and growth through the action of various hormones. Finally, we'll understand the crucial role of hormones and the endocrine system in animals, bringing together all key concepts related to control and coordination.
